messages.subject: Expired pardiso
parts:
Hello, 
I am going back to some old analyses and my pardiso license had expired. I've obtained a new license, however, when I check to ensure it is working with inla.pardiso.check() I get an error message that says: ""FAILURE: PARDISO IS NOT INSTALLED OR NOT WORKING"  
I've tried several times to install Pardiso, and tried getting licenses for version 6.0 and 7.2 but havent had any success getting it working. Any advice? 

Thanks, 
Ben

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Expired pardiso
parts:
you need to follow the link provided with

inla.pardiso()

and use R-4.2 and the most recent testing version (which is the better
one...)

it should be for 7.2 only.

you can also set it directly

inla.setOption(pardiso.license='.....')

and then check with

inla.pardiso.check()

let me know
H
